description.zh:
身份证号：

说明
仅支持二代居民身份证和港澳台居住证的证件号码。

- paramType 传 normal 时：传入身份证号明文。

- paramType 传 md5 时：传入身份证号密文。
description.en:
ID card number:

Note
Only the ID numbers of the second-generation resident ID card and Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan residence permits are supported.

- When paramType is set to normal: pass in the ID card number in plaintext.

- When paramType is set to md5: pass in the encrypted ID card number.

description.zh:
手机号：

- paramType 传 normal 时：传入手机号明文。

- paramType 传 md5 时：传入手机号密文。
description.en:
Mobile number:

- When paramType is set to normal: pass in the mobile number in plaintext.

- When paramType is set to md5: pass in the encrypted mobile number.

description.zh:
加密方式：

- normal：明文不加密

- md5：MD5加密
description.en:
Encryption method:

- normal: plaintext, no encryption

- md5: MD5 encryption

description.zh:
姓名：

- paramType 传 normal 时：传入姓名明文。

- paramType 传 md5 时：传入姓名密文。
description.en:
Name:

- When paramType is set to normal: pass in the name in plaintext.

- When paramType is set to md5: pass in the encrypted name.

title.zh: 手机号三要素简版接口
title.en: Simplified Mobile Number Three-Factor Verification API

descriptions.zh:
- 服务地址：cloudauth.aliyuncs.com（IPv4）或cloudauth-dualstack.aliyuncs.com（IPv6）。
- 请求方法：POST和GET。
- 传输协议：HTTPS。
descriptions.en:
- Service address: cloudauth.aliyuncs.com (IPv4) or cloudauth-dualstack.aliyuncs.com (IPv6).
- Request method: POST and GET.
- Transfer protocol: HTTPS.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudauth mobile-3-meta-simple-verify --param-type normal --identify-num '明文：429001000000008211_密文：_32fa7bcd874161bea8ec8fd98f390ec9' --user-name '明文：张三_密文：_32fa7bcd874161bea8ec8fd98f390ec9' --mobile '明文：18600002055_密文：_849169cd3b20621c1c78bd61a11a4fc2' --api-version 2019-03-07 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudauth Mobile3MetaSimpleVerify --region cn-hangzhou --UserName '明文：张三_密文：_32fa7bcd874161bea8ec8fd98f390ec9' --IdentifyNum '明文：429001000000008211_密文：_32fa7bcd874161bea8ec8fd98f390ec9' --Mobile '明文：18600002055_密文：_849169cd3b20621c1c78bd61a11a4fc2' --ParamType normal
